_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Wena u-Player {player_id} emdlalweni we-Liar's Dice wababhali abangamashumi {num_players}.
Mithetho:
- Ngemvulo wakho, ungasenzo ukudlala noma:
  1) Ukwenza kubudlela okusha nodumo oludidekelwe noma face eliphezulu (noma zombili) kulendlela ekhona; noma '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Ukukhuluma kubudlela lokugcina kwa kubhala '[Call]'.

Ukungikhuluma:
  - Izinga lombowo le-face leyo kuleyo maphakathi ne-ti-dice zonke liphansi kulendlela, umkhubi wokugcina uphume induku.
  - Ngakho, umkhubi uphume induku.
Umklami ongowamaduze angaphumelela. Umklami ophila kuphela ushaya.

board.new_round:
Mzulo wetshele - Ti-dice tingalawuli: {dice_summary}
Ti-dice sakho sikhona: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} calls! The actual count of face {face_value} is {count}, which is LESS than {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (the last bidder) loses one die.
call.caller_loses:
Player {current_player_id} ikhuluma! Inomboro yalombowo ye-face {face_value} ni {count}, leyo ingaphezulu kwaleyo {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (umkhubi) uphume induku.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Call made with no prior bid.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Action not recognized as either a valid '[Bid: X, Y]' or '[Call]'. Submitted action: {action}

bid_reason.face_lower: Inomboro yetshele yomtsengwa {new_face_value} ingaphansi kwaleyo lekhona {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.face_range: Linani lelibekiwe kumele libe emkhatsini wa 1 na 6.
